notes.title: Full Release is Here!
notes.content: [h2]You Are The Code is now out of Early Access![/h2][p][/p][h3]Notable changes since the initial July Early Access release:[/h3][list][*][p]30 new levels! Bringing the total to [b]150[/b]![/p][/*][*][p]New mechanics![/p][/*][*][p]Escaping from "You Are The Code Operating System" (YATC-OS) is now possible![/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Workshop[/b] support! Make levels and share them with the community![/p][/*][*][p]Lore![/p][/*][*][p]New Achievements![/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Nearing the END GAME on the Beta Branch
notes.content: [p]With this build, you are now VERY close to being able to escape YATC-OS![/p][p][/p][p](remember, the Steam Workshop was the previous update. Check that out if you haven't)[/p][p][/p][p]Change log: [/p][list][*][p]3 NEW FOLDERS with levels! Bringing the total level count to 149 (the next update will get us to the 150 mark) The folders are: timelines, toolbox, and yatc_escape_hatch,[/p][/*][*][p]LORE: The creator of YATC, Dr. Loc, now has some logs that he left (journal entries) to add more lore to the game. These have been sprinkled through out the existing levels (spoiler at the bottom if you want to know where to look),[/p][/*][*][p]Folder order in part2 has slightly changed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I know everyone must be very busy playing Silksong, but if you could spare a few minutes to try out the beta branch, that would be amazing :-)[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix for alphabet and missing word
notes.content:
A bug snuck into the previous build that made alphabet level 2 and missing word level 4 unsolvable. This has now been fixed! 

Tests have been added for this case so it should be much harder for bugs like this to occur in the future

notes.title: Workshop is Released!
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301950/7b1ef13c8ca941d8cfd55ed9d4ac0c9325fe9b12.png"][/img][/p][p]The Steam workshop is now supported on the main branch of You Are The Code! That means you can easily play levels created by members of the community! You can even upload your own from within the game![/p][p][/p][p]Now go share your creations![/p]

notes.title: New Levels on the Main Branch!
notes.content:
These folders that were previously on the Beta branch are now on the main branch!

[b]Blackout Curtain
Equations
Multi Commands[/b]

That's [b]16 new levels [/b]in the base game! Play them now!

notes.title: Steam Workshop Support & More Levels On The Beta Branch!
notes.content: [p]The Steam Workshop is now usable on the beta branch![/p][p][/p][p]That means you can now upload levelpacks from within the game to the Steam Workshop to share with your friends! To subscribe to levelpacks, use the default Steam UI (this may change in the future). [/p][p][/p][p]There are 15 total levels on the beta branch, in the folders[/p][list][*][p]blackout_curtain[/p][/*][*][p]equations[/p][/*][*][p]multi_commands[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please share your feedback on the discord![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/MM4Jm24wjR" style="button"]Join Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: New Public Beta Branch - 4 New Levels - Blackout Curtain
notes.content: [h2]Blackout Curtain[/h2][p]The public beta branch is out for You Are The Code! 4 new levels in a new folder, "blackout_curtain/", are awaiting your feedback. Save data is stored separately from the main game.[/p][p][/p][h2]Joining The Beta[/h2][p]In your steam library, right click You Are The Code -> properties -> click the "betas" tab -> beta participation -> "beta ..."[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix: Fixes Gems Getting Deleted
notes.content: [p]A hotfix has been released to address a bug that caused players to lose gems, and therefore unable to progress. If this happened to you, your save should automatically fix itself.[/p]
